title: Beyond Statistical Priors: Architecture-Agnostic Data-Free Knowledge Distillation via Unified Explicit Semantics
abstract: arXiv:2608.09287v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Data-Free Knowledge Distillation (DFKD) transfers knowledge from a pretrained teacher model to a compact student model by synthesizing semantically informative data, eliminating the need for access to the original training dataset. Existing DFKD methods rely heavily on architecture-specific statistical priors (e.g., Batch Normalization statistics) to guide data synthesis; however, such architecture-dependent priors are often absent in modern architectures such as Vision Transformers (ViTs), resulting in degraded semantic quality of the synthesized data and consequently catastrophic performance degradation. In this paper, we propose UniDFKD, a unified data-free knowledge distillation framework that replaces architecture-specific statistics with explicit, architecture-agnostic semantic priors. tldr: 该论文提出UniDFKD框架，用显式的架构无关语义先验取代传统DFKD依赖的批归一化统计等架构特定先验，使无数据知识蒸馏能够有效应用于ViT等现代架构。
